Future<void> main() async {

  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"language":"go"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('package main\n\nimport "fmt"\n\nfunc main() {\n\tfmt.Println("hello")\n}\n', config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.language);
    stdout.writeln(result.structure);
    stdout.writeln(result.structure[0].kind);
    stdout.writeln(result.imports);
